faq.q: How much does an Estepona boat charter sunset cruise with romantic dinner cost in 2028?
faq.a: For a sunset cruise with dinner, our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day, which includes skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The Mangusta 80, a larger luxury option, costs €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and includes a jet ski. For other yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Pershing 46, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I have a romantic dinner on board during the sunset cruise?
faq.a: Yes, we can arrange a romantic dinner on board for your Estepona boat charter sunset cruise. The standard package includes light snacks, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. For a more elaborate dinner, we can coordinate with local caterers or beach clubs along the coast – just let us know your preferences when booking, and we’ll tailor the menu.

faq.q: What is the best time for a sunset cruise from Estepona?
faq.a: The best time is typically 1.5 to 2 hours before sunset, which in 2028 ranges from around 19:30 in early summer to 17:30 in late September. This allows you to sail out, anchor at a scenic spot like Cabopino or Cala del Faro, and watch the sun dip below the Mediterranean while enjoying your dinner. We recommend booking a 2-hour charter for a classic sunset experience.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a sunset cruise with dinner?
faq.a: We have a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús, just 30 minutes from Estepona. For a romantic evening, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect – both are Tier A and start at €749/2h. If you want more space, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is a stunning choice from €4,719/4h. Other yachts like the Pershing 46 or Ferretti 94 are available on request.

faq.q: Are drinks and food included in the sunset cruise price?
faq.a: Yes, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For a romantic dinner, we can upgrade the catering – for example, a seafood platter or a private chef – at an additional cost. Just mention your dinner wishes when you book.

faq.q: Can we depart from Estepona Marina instead of Puerto Banús?
faq.a: All our boats depart from Puerto Banús in Marbella, which is about a 30-minute drive from Estepona. We can arrange a private transfer from your hotel in Estepona to Puerto Banús if needed – just ask when booking.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad on the day of my sunset cruise?
faq.a: Safety is our priority. If the captain deems conditions unsafe due to wind or storms, we’ll reschedule your cruise for another date or offer a full refund. In 2028, we expect typical Mediterranean summer weather – calm seas and 25-30°C – but we always monitor forecasts closely and keep you informed.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book for a 2028 sunset cruise?
faq.a: For popular sunset slots in July and August, we recommend booking at least 2-3 months in advance, especially for weekends. For a more flexible schedule, booking 2-4 weeks ahead usually works. Since 2028 is a leap year with many special events, early booking ensures you get your preferred boat and time.

data.body_html:
Imagine gliding along the Costa del Sol as the sun melts into the Mediterranean, a glass of cava in hand, with your partner beside you. That’s exactly what an Estepona boat charter sunset cruise with romantic dinner delivers – and in 2028, it’s more accessible than you think. Departing from Puerto Banús, just 30 minutes from Estepona, our fleet offers intimate and luxurious options to make your evening unforgettable. Whether you choose a sporty open boat or a 24-metre flybridge, every charter includes a skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT, so you can focus on the moment.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise from Puerto Banús for Estepona?

Puerto Banús is the perfect launch point for an Estepona boat charter sunset cruise. The marina is a 30-minute drive from Estepona’s old town, and once you’re on the water, you’ll cruise past Marbella’s Golden Mile, the iconic La Concha mountain, and the quiet coves of Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. The sunset views are spectacular, with the sky turning shades of orange and pink behind the Sierra Blanca. Our boats depart from the heart of the action, so you can combine a sunset sail with dinner at one of the beach clubs or a romantic meal on board.

Our 2028 Fleet for Romantic Sunset Charters

We have a variety of boats to suit couples and small groups. For an intimate evening, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal – both are Tier A and start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. If you want to impress, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a luxurious flybridge and a free jet ski, priced at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. For other yachts like the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), pricing is on request via WhatsApp – we’ll tailor a package to your needs.

What’s Included in Your Romantic Dinner Cruise?

Every Estepona boat charter sunset cruise includes a welcome drink of cava, a selection of light snacks, and a fully stocked bar with white wine and beer. For a romantic dinner, we can arrange a gourmet picnic basket with local delicacies, or a private chef to prepare a multi-course meal on board. The standard package is perfect for a sunset toast, but if you’re celebrating an anniversary or a proposal, we recommend upgrading to a bespoke dinner menu – just let us know your preferences when booking. The skipper will anchor at a quiet cove, like Cala del Faro, so you can dine in privacy as the sun sets.

Best Sunset Spots Along the Estepona Coast

The coastline between Puerto Banús and Estepona is dotted with hidden gems. Our favourite sunset anchorages include Cabopino, a charming marina with a sandy beach, and Cala del Faro, a secluded cove near Marbella. Further south, the waters off Estepona’s old town offer a stunning backdrop of the Sierra Bermeja mountains. On a calm evening, we can cruise all the way to Sotogrande for a longer charter – the 8-hour option gives you plenty of time to explore. The skipper will choose the best spot based on wind and sea conditions, ensuring a smooth and scenic ride.

How to Book Your 2028 Sunset Cruise

Booking your Estepona boat charter sunset cruise with romantic dinner is simple. Visit our fleet page to see all available boats, then send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat, and any dinner requests. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online – prices start at €749 for 2 hours. For other yachts, we’ll send a personalised quote within 24 hours. We recommend booking at least 2-3 months in advance for summer 2028, especially for weekend sunset slots, as they sell out quickly. Check our detailed guide for more tips on planning your perfect evening.

What to Expect on the Day of Your Cruise

On the day of your cruise, you’ll meet your skipper at Puerto Banús – we’ll send exact berth details after booking. Arrive 15 minutes early to settle in and meet the crew. The boat is fully equipped with safety gear, and the skipper will give a short briefing. As you leave the marina, you’ll feel the Mediterranean breeze and see the Marbella skyline. The standard 2-hour sunset cruise is perfect for a romantic evening, but if you want more time to swim or explore, consider the 4-hour or 8-hour options. All our boats have shaded areas and comfortable seating, so you can relax in style.

Alternative Ideas for a Romantic Evening

If a sunset cruise isn’t enough, combine it with a dinner at one of the beach clubs along the coast, such as Ocean Club Marbella or Salvador María in Estepona. We can arrange a transfer from the boat to the restaurant and back. Alternatively, extend your charter to include a daytime swim at Cabo de Plata or a visit to the Buenavista lighthouse. For a truly unforgettable proposal, our team can decorate the boat with flowers and arrange a photographer – just ask when booking. For more inspiration, read our blog on romantic boat experiences in Marbella.
